thread:
ada-lee: Hey payroll, I just got my provisional W-2 and the stock comp shows up twice — RSU income in Box 1 and also a Box 12 code V amount. My Box 1 looks inflated and federal withholding seems doubled. Anyone see this?
comp-payroll: Hi @ada-lee, can you attach a screenshot of the W-2 (mask SSN)? Also share the vest date(s) and any payout stub you received.
ada-lee: Attached DM with redacted W-2 and the Feb 22 vest paystub. Vest payout was $12,000 and I see withholding of $4,000 on the stub. On the W-2: Box 1 = $88,500 (includes $12,000), Box 12 code V = $12,000, Box 2 withheld = $6,800 which seems higher than the stub.
equity-team: Quick context: equity system sends a fed supplemental tax entry to payroll and also flags the gross for regular wages. Looks like both the supplemental tax and gross were reported and then payroll also included the gross again in Box 12.
comp-payroll: Confirming: our ingest shows two records for that vest event — one labeled "Equity supplemental - fed withholding" and another as "Regular wage - equity gross". The payroll engine should consolidate, but a merge key failed because the equity event ID changed when the legacy equity feed retried. That likely caused duplicate reporting.
payroll-bot: Ticket created: PR-55823 "W-2 duplicate RSU reporting for ada-lee". Initial ETA: provider validation 48 hrs.
eric-peopleops: This is a tricky one for year-end. If Box 1 contains the RSU gross and Box 12 has code V, that's normal, but double withholding can happen if supplemental taxes were also submitted as separate payroll entries.
tax-advisor: If withholding was doubled, the employee is owed a refund or employer needs to file a corrected W-2 (W-2c). Steps: 1) validate payroll XMLs submitted to ADP/GlobalPay for the vest pay date, 2) confirm withheld amount per paystub vs reported Box 2, 3) request reversal/credit in the payroll system if duplicate tax was withheld, 4) issue W-2c if reporting to SSA is incorrect.
ada-lee: Timeline? I need this sorted before I file taxes. I paid estimated taxes in April already, worried about mismatch.
comp-payroll: Operational plan: - We will pull the raw feeds and identify the duplicate event ID - If duplicates caused extra withholding, we will reverse the duplicate withholding on next payroll as a separate adjusting line and issue a corrected paystub. - If SSA already received the wrong totals, we'll prepare a W-2c and notify you. We aim to have a remediation plan in 5 business days.
equity-team: We'll also patch the retry logic on the equity feed so an unchanged vest event doesn't create a new feed ID on retry. That will stop duplicates.
payroll-bot: PR-55823 updated: change request noted, remediation path added.
tax-advisor: Note for ada-lee: when the employer issues a W-2c, it can change your Box 1/Box 2 amounts and you'll need the corrected copy to file. If you have already filed, amended return may be required depending on the delta. We'll provide guidance once the corrections are final.
eric-peopleops: Finance approved a provisional net reimbursement if the correction takes more than one payroll cycle and the withhold was >$1,000 extra. Will confirm in the ticket.
ada-lee: Thanks all. Please keep me posted here and attach the corrected stub/W-2c when ready. Appreciate the fast triage :pray:
